task: T-DA-07 fix v2 — diff-based verification gate (Option A)
scorerVersion: 2 — audited 2026-10-08; F2/F3 section-presence guards; F4 Article-99-or-no-6%; F5 positive-term guard; no-draft status on length < 200 chars

baseline.source: T-DA-05 V1 final (draft-v3) and V2 final (draft-v4), re-scored with corrected scorer
baseline.persistentFlaw: F1 — Annex III / Article 6 citation never added across 3 rounds

control.description: No diff-verification gate — same setup as T-DA-05 V1 supervisor run

treatment.description: Option A: after each draft write, middleware diffs draft-vN vs draft-v(N-1) and runs a Groq single-call judge per feedback item; blocks if any item judged not-addressed
treatment.groqRole: single-call judge per item per round — not a measurement tool (judge calibration failed 2/3 in T-DA-05)

processGates.validRun: final committed draft exists (scoreDraft returns status='scored')
processGates.invalidRun: no committed final draft (status='no-draft') — count as process failure, exclude from flaw score, report separately

primaryMetric.name: seeded_flaws_fixed_median
primaryMetric.description: Median flawsFixed across n=3 scored runs per condition (runs with status=no-draft excluded from median but counted as failures)
primaryMetric.gate: treatment median ≥ 4 AND ≥ 1 process-complete run per condition
primaryMetric.gateRationale: Corrected baseline is 4/5; gate must be at least equal to baseline to demonstrate improvement. ≥4/5 means F1 still not fixed (expected) but all other 4 fixed.

secondaryMetrics.name: rounds_completed
secondaryMetrics.description: Number of critic rounds before convergence or cap

secondaryMetrics.name: gate_triggered_corrections
secondaryMetrics.description: Number of times the diff-gate blocked a write and the model successfully adapted (wrote a corrected draft on retry)
secondaryMetrics.note: Distinguishes gate effectiveness from gate-induced termination (T-DA-07 v1 failure mode)

secondaryMetrics.name: process_failure_rate
secondaryMetrics.description: Fraction of runs with no committed final draft (status=no-draft)

secondaryMetrics.name: cost_per_run
secondaryMetrics.description: supervisor AIMessage token sum × $0.75/$4.50 per 1M; Groq judge calls billed separately at Groq rates

preRegisteredFailureModes.name: Groq judge unreliable at item level
preRegisteredFailureModes.prediction: Groq single-call judge may mark items as 'not addressed' when the diff does address them (false negatives on item-level judgment). This would cause the gate to block valid drafts and could reproduce the T-DA-07 recursion-limit failure.
preRegisteredFailureModes.detection: Count gate blocks in treatment runs; if process_failure_rate > 0 and gate_triggered_corrections = 0, this failure mode is active.
preRegisteredFailureModes.mitigation: Use a majority-vote across 3 single Groq calls per item (3 calls → take 2/3); or fall back to structural heuristics (diff line count > 0 for sections touching the item) if judge fails calibration check.

preRegisteredFailureModes.name: Model still batches all writes in one turn
preRegisteredFailureModes.prediction: Even with a post-write diff gate, the model may batch draft-vN write + notes write in a single AIMessage. If the draft write is gated and returned an error, the notes write in the same batch may be skipped by the model on the next turn.
preRegisteredFailureModes.detection: If gate_triggered_corrections = 0 across all 3 treatment runs (gate fires but model never adapts), this failure mode is active.
preRegisteredFailureModes.mitigation: Switch to wrapModelCall to inject unaddressed items into context before each model call — changes the model's generation plan rather than blocking post-hoc.

preRegisteredFailureModes.name: F1 remains unfixed in all runs
preRegisteredFailureModes.prediction: F1 (Annex III / Article 6 citation in high-risk section) was not fixed in T-DA-05 V1, V2, or T-DA-07. Expected to remain unfixed; gate cannot require fixing F1 since it was not fixed in the baseline.
preRegisteredFailureModes.detection: scoreDraft details[F1].fixed = false in all runs — expected outcome, not a failure.
preRegisteredFailureModes.mitigation: No mitigation needed. F1 requires the model to proactively add a citation not present in the original draft — a production-quality addition, not a removal of an error.

modelCalls.baselinePerRun: ~6 supervisor model calls (3 rounds × ~2 calls per round)
modelCalls.treatmentPerRun: ~6 supervisor model calls + ~7–14 Groq judge calls (1 per item per blocked write; 7 feedback items × 0–2 blocks)
modelCalls.note: Groq calls are sequential per BRC pattern (single-call roles only); add ~$0.0002 per Groq call at Groq rates

estimatedCosts.estimatedTotalCost: $0.40–$0.65 for 6 runs (3 control + 3 treatment) at primary model pricing
estimatedCosts.costBasis: $0.75/$4.50 per 1M input/output for gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17; ~$0.001–$0.003 per run for Groq judge

stopConditions: All 3 runs per condition complete with status=scored OR status=no-draft recorded
If all 3 treatment runs hit recursion limit (process_failure_rate=1.0), abort and record FP4/FP5 as active — do not continue to n=3
notes: Do not run any v2 fix experiment until this file exists — pre-registration timestamp must precede results.json timestamp
Groq judge calibration failed 2/3 in T-DA-05 — judge steers the loop only; do NOT use judge scores as the primary flaw measurement
Primary flaw measurement is always scoreDraft on the committed final draft text, not judge output
